tools.listingTodos: Looking through to-dos in the notes
tools.@readingDatabase: a line in the assistant's panel while it reads a database; {title} is the database's title

changes.@createAssignment: the heading of a change the assistant proposes, before the person allows it; {title} is the new assignment's title
changes.@createdAssignment: what the assistant did, after the person allowed it; {title} is the new assignment's title
changes.@updateAssignment: the heading of a change the assistant proposes to an existing assignment; {title} is the assignment's title
changes.@updatedAssignment: what the assistant did to an existing assignment; {title} is the assignment's title
changes.@createEvent: the heading of a change the assistant proposes: a new event on the calendar; {title} is the event's title
changes.@createdEvent: what the assistant did: it added an event to the calendar; {title} is the event's title
changes.@updateEvent: the heading of a change the assistant proposes to an existing calendar event; {title} is the event's title
changes.@updatedEvent: what the assistant did to an existing calendar event; {title} is the event's title
changes.@tickTodo: the heading of a change the assistant proposes: ticking a to-do item in a note; {text} is the item's text
changes.@untickTodo: the heading of a change the assistant proposes: unticking a to-do item in a note; {text} is the item's text
changes.@tickedTodo: what the assistant did: it ticked a to-do item in a note; {text} is the item's text
changes.@untickedTodo: what the assistant did: it unticked a to-do item in a note; {text} is the item's text
changes.@addRows: the heading of a change the assistant proposes: adding rows to a database; {title} is the database's title
changes.@addedRows: what the assistant did: it added rows to a database; {title} is the database's title
changes.@updateRows: the heading of a change the assistant proposes: changing the values of rows in databases; {count} is how many rows
changes.@updatedRows: what the assistant did: it changed the values of rows in databases; {count} is how many rows

labels.@due: label of a detail of an assignment: when it is due
labels.@course: label of a detail of an assignment or event: the course it belongs to
labels.@priority: label of a detail of an assignment: how important it is
labels.@notes: label of a detail of an assignment or event: the short text written with it
labels.title: Title
labels.@title: label of a detail of an assignment, event or database row: its title, shown when the assistant renames it
labels.@status: label of a detail of an assignment: whether it is to do, being done or done
labels.@starts: label of a detail of an event: its first date and time
labels.@ends: label of a detail of an event: its last date and time
labels.@location: label of a detail of an event: where it takes place
labels.@repeats: label of a detail of an event: how often it comes back
labels.@until: label of a detail of an event: the last date a repeating event falls on
labels.@note: label of a detail of a to-do: the note it is written in (followed by that note's title)

values.@none: shown in place of a value that is empty or not set, in a change the assistant proposes
values.@change: an old value and the new one, in a change the assistant proposes; {from} is the old value, {to} the new one
values.@propertyValue: a database property and the value a new row gets, in a change the assistant proposes; {name} is the property's name, {value} the value
values.@propertyChange: a database property with its old and new value, in a change the assistant proposes; {name} is the property's name, {from} the old value, {to} the new one

priority.@low: a priority of an assignment, shown in a change the assistant proposes
priority.@medium: a priority of an assignment, shown in a change the assistant proposes
priority.@high: a priority of an assignment, shown in a change the assistant proposes

status.@todo: the status of an assignment that is not started, shown in a change the assistant proposes
status.@doing: the status of an assignment that is under way, shown in a change the assistant proposes
status.@done: the status of an assignment that is finished, shown in a change the assistant proposes
